_comment: QA driver roster: who can be recommended to run QA for a change. /qa:plan and qa-status-gate.sh recommend a driver (default = the entry whose `default` is true); the agent takes a best guess, the human approves or refines, and the chosen driver is named IN THE PR BODY with their `handle`. Handles verified 2026-06-07 against GitHub: the Mu fleet accounts carry the -ai suffix (the bare mutwo/muthree/mufour logins are unrelated). Keep this list current as the fleet changes.

drivers.label: MuTwo
drivers.notes: Primary Mu clone. Deploys the feature branch to the real host and drives the real flow, then records EVIDENCE. The default driver when nothing points elsewhere.

drivers.label: MuThree
drivers.notes: Mu clone. Recommend when MuThree owns the repo or host the change runs on.

drivers.label: MuFour
drivers.notes: Mu clone. Recommend when MuFour owns the repo or host the change runs on.

drivers.label: Mujtaba
drivers.notes: The human. Recommend when the change needs his taste/judgment, or when only he holds the live session or real data to exercise it. Hand him the exact command; this ends the turn, with dev_verified recorded after his thumbs-up.

drivers.label: Claude (this session's agent)
drivers.notes: The building agent. Recommend when the flow is automatable and this session can deploy + drive it now and record EVIDENCE. No GitHub handle: name it in the PR as 'the building agent (this session)'.

excluded.reason: GitHub-flagged / ineligible (account parked); do not recommend.
